candidate_fields.assigned_filament_id: one of the ids in filament_inventory.json
candidate_fields.est_filament_g: number > 0, or null if unknown — never 0
candidate_fields.fit_context: why the assigned filament fits (or does not)
candidate_fields.licence: verbatim licence string from the model's page (required)
candidate_fields.market_evidence: one line of real evidence (buyer / price / demand actually observed)
candidate_fields.market_grade: H|M|L — only with a one-line evidence string in market_evidence
candidate_fields.retrieved_at_utc: ISO timestamp from the source record, where provided
candidate_fields.sellable: must be true, with sellable_reason from the trend-scraper record
candidate_fields.sellable_reason: e.g. 'licence: CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use'
candidate_fields.title: model title from the source record

_schema.description: Sellable-print Feed track candidates, sourced from the verified trend-scraper build (~/workspace/pineapple/builds/trend-scraper/). A candidate may be seeded ONLY when its trend-scraper record is genuinely sellable: sellable == true, which that build grants only when a verbatim licence from the model's own page affirmatively permits commercial use. Licence unknown => sellable:false is that build's hard default and is respected here — never inherited, never assumed, never fabricated.

seed_verdict: EMPTY — inspected 2026-11-17: the trend-scraper build's verified output (data/trend_records.json) holds 28 records and every one is sellable:false with licence null/unknown (20 gui_paste, 5 google_trends, 3 printables). Its licence fixture cases (tests/fixtures/licence_cases.json) are unit-test fixtures for the licence classifier, not real candidates, and were not seeded. No record qualifies, so this list ships empty rather than fabricated.
